summary: NQ and ES both reclaimed the ATR stops they lost yesterday and closed green while VIX fell 6.59% to 15.31. The September jobs report was cancelled by the shutdown, so the tape ran on flows, not data. Both indices faded off early highs into the close. Gold rolled to the December contract and reversed from 4,259 to close 4,172, and crude whipsawed to 88.20 before reclaiming its stop to close 91.27.

event.name: September jobs report (NFP) cancelled, government shutdown data blackout
event.actual: No release. The BLS jobs report was blacked out by the federal shutdown.
event.surprise: The print that was supposed to anchor the day did not happen, so the market traded on positioning and flows.
event.nqReaction: NQ reclaimed its ATR stop and closed up 0.91% at 31,049, fading off a 31,282 RTH high. VIX dropped 6.59% to 15.31.
event.crossAsset: Gold rolled to December (MGC2!) and reversed from 4,259 to close 4,172 down 0.85%. Crude whipsawed to 88.20 then closed 91.27 down 1.79%.

risk.note: Week ahead: the shutdown keeps federal data (jobs, CPI) on hold, so expect a thin, headline-driven tape into the Oct 5 week. Keep size standard and let the stop reclaims prove themselves before pressing. Gold now trades the December contract (MGC2!) after the October roll, so size gold off the new basis.

psychology: When the data you were waiting on does not show up, the easy mistake is forcing a read out of noise. The jobs report got cancelled, but your levels do not care. Trade the stop reclaims and the ranges that are actually in front of you, keep size standard, and let the thinner tape be a reason for patience.
